body: Worker rule (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-23 01:38Z, my own miss on w-3c44 GREEN test-cc5547a2). Before EVERY test or compile launch, READ the coordinator mailbox as well as the run census, including a launch triggered by a resume wait firing. A queue correction may have arrived queued behind my active turn. Fable2 #3323 (01:31:10Z) put me 5th for the single +1 beside Merger's gate. I launched at about 01:31:45Z on a test-run wait firing, after a census-only check, and took Sol-03d4's slot. The census showing one gate running does not mean the +1 is mine: the coordinator orders the +1 queue. A resume wait on another lane's run is a wake, never a GO.
